title: Law to raise income limit for senior and disabled homeowner tax breaks
summary: This bill would raise the maximum household income allowed to qualify for the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption and the Disabled Homeowners' Exemption from $50,000 to $75,000, starting July 1, 2027. It also updates the sliding-scale income brackets used to determine the size of each homeowner's partial property tax exemption. The exemptions reduce the taxable assessed value of homes owned by eligible low-income seniors and people with disabilities.
